wooden_cabinet_1_top_region.correct_classification: DYNAMIC_UNSEALED — has movable ancestor (hinge joint). The site may appear static across the limited canonical states sampled, but the hinge means it CAN move. Must not be sealed as static.

white_cabinet_1_bottom_region.classification: CORRECT — non-static, movable ancestor detected and position drift confirms

basket_1_contain_region.classification: CORRECT — non-static (dynamic object). V1 correctly identifies as non-static but does not attempt body→site reconstruction. V2 must add DYNAMIC_RECONSTRUCTABLE classification.

v1_defects.root_cause: V1 criterion only checks pos/rot drift <= 1e-6, does not check has_movable_ancestor
v1_defects.impact: wooden_cabinet world pose would be incorrectly sealed as static, causing C3-G geometry errors for any task using this fixture
v1_defects.fix: C3-S2 must add 'AND NOT has_movable_ancestor' to static criterion

v1_defects.root_cause: V1 uses set of site_name strings, ignoring that same site name in different tasks/suites may have different model contexts
v1_defects.impact: Potential cross-task pose collision if same site name used in multiple BDDL files
v1_defects.fix: C3-S2 must use task-bound composite keys: suite/task_idx/BDDL_SHA/model_SHA/site_name

v1_defects.root_cause: V1 treats basket as generic non-static fixture, does not attempt body→site reconstruction
v1_defects.impact: basket pose unavailable for C3-G geometry checks, reducing supported placement coverage
v1_defects.fix: C3-S2 must validate T_site_world = T_body_world * T_site_body reconstruction

verdict: PARTIAL — 6/9 correctly static, 2/9 correctly non-static, 1/9 (wooden_cabinet) MISCLASSIFIED. The V1 seal is VALID as a historical record but MUST NOT be used as the static pose source for C3-G. C3-S2 must supersede it.
